description: This file defines a web scraper class 'Meljoulwan' for extracting recipe information from meljoulwan.com, including methods for author, title, category, total time, prep time, cook time, yields, ingredients, ingredient groups, instructions, and language.

classes.name: Meljoulwan
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from meljoulwan.com, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author's name from the recipe page.

methods.name: _extract_info
methods.description: Helper method to extract information based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time for the recipe, summing prep and cook times if necessary.
